title: D-087 BLUEPRINT-1: zero-dependency vector PDF site-plan sheet writer - lot + proposed building to scale with dimension strings, scale bar, grid-north arrow, title block and the proposed-not-a-city-record label; round-trips through the in-repo PDF reader (module + tests; no route, no UI)
objective: Build services/api/app/cad/pdf_sheet_writer.py: a deterministic, dependency-free PDF 1.4 writer (uncompressed content streams, a standard Type1 font, exact xref offsets) that draws a one-page site plan from canonical EPSG:2263 rings: lot outline, building footprint, per-edge dimension strings in feet (computed server-side from the 2263 coordinates, rounding declared), a chosen plot scale that fits the sheet with margins + scale bar, a GRID-north arrow labeled as EPSG:2263 grid north (never 'true north'), and a title block (address/BBL from inputs, generated_at, generator version, 'PROPOSED - NOT A CITY RECORD', 'Not for construction - professional review required'). The writer emits only constructs inside the in-repo survey reader's subset (lines, rectangles, text) so tests can round-trip its bytes through that reader.
business_reason: The owner asked for blueprint WRITING (D-087-R005): a scaled, dimensioned site-plan sheet is the printable drawing architects expect, generated from the same canonical geometry the checks use.
